title: Platform Compatibility Gate
scope: Local deterministic verification of platform capability matrix, input mode support, filesystem behavior, packaging boundaries, upgrade/downgrade compatibility, and uninstall boundaries on the canonical Windows repository.

budgets.metric: Desktop (Windows/macOS/Linux) declares localFileSystem + projectSqliteDatabase + readOnlySqlite; Web does not claim project persistence; capability gaps produce actionable typed errors
Keyboard navigation: Tab/Shift+Tab traversal, keyboard shortcuts, Enter/Escape actions reachable; no overflow at narrow layout
Project packages use real local filesystem folders; SQLite via drift NativeDatabase; read-only SQLite access for recovery/audit; path injection available in tests
Windows build package integrity verified via debug build gate; packaging boundaries fail-closed for unsupported platform capabilities
Project format major 1 / schema 16 / database schema 62 backward-compatible; migration dry-run fail-closed; future-schema rejection
budgets.unit: contract compatibility verified via schema assertions

budgets.metric: Uninstall boundaries: platform capability model declares Desktop vs Web honestly; no destructive uninstall action claimed without capability

baseline.profile: Windows debug build + contract compatibility schema freeze

bottlenecks.impact: Desktop capabilities are tested via injected isWeb flag; actual native macOS/Linux runtime capability matrix and uninstall boundary effects are not captured from cron.
bottlenecks.next_gate: Native platform matrix and uninstall journey verification on release-candidate hardware.

bottlenecks.impact: Windows debug build compilation is verified; signed production MSI/installer packaging and uninstall registry cleanup are not captured from cron.
bottlenecks.next_gate: Windows installer packaging and uninstall verification on release-candidate hardware.

findings.summary: No failure occurred in the executed platform compatibility matrix; PlatformCapabilitySet declares Desktop vs Web honestly with actionable typed errors; keyboard navigation and contract/schema compatibility verified.

residual_risk_acceptance.acceptance: Native macOS/Linux runtime capability matrix and Windows installer/uninstall cleanup deferred to release-candidate operational validation.

limits: Native macOS/Linux runtime platform matrix is not captured; Desktop vs Web capabilities are tested via injected isWeb flag only.
Windows debug build compilation is verified; signed production MSI/installer packaging is not captured.
Native uninstall boundary effects and registry cleanup are not captured from cron.
Hosted CI, signing, hardware, and public release remain UNVERIFIABLE.
This decision is not a production platform compatibility certification.
